referents.why: Second masculine singular suffix 'you' inside Moses's speech; the addressee of that speech is Pharaoh, to whom Moses has been answering since 8.5.
Second masculine singular 'your' on 'houses'; the speech's addressee is Pharaoh (the same address as in the preceding verse's 'from you and from your houses').
Second masculine singular 'your' on 'officials'; the possessor is the single addressee, Pharaoh.
Second masculine singular 'your' on 'people'; the possessor is the single addressee, Pharaoh.
Third feminine plural 'they will remain'; the only feminine plural candidate is 'frogs' (w3), the subject of the clause before, and the frogs are the sensible doer of remaining in the Nile.
referents.category: implied subject continuing the previous clause's subject

links.why: cl4 is not a clause of this verse (it belongs to the earlier verse), and 'and then' links a wayyiqtol sequence within a verse only; this weqatal is an announcement continuing Moses's speech, not the next narrative event after 'you may know'.
links.category: cross-verse then link on a speech continuation

groups.why: Both clauses are Moses's announcement to Pharaoh: second person 'you / your' throughout is Pharaoh; there is no frame clause here because the speech opened in the verse before and runs on.
groups.category: speech continuing across a verse boundary

none_fit.what: 'Only in the Nile they will remain' is a restriction or exception on the departure of the frogs (the frogs leave everywhere except the Nile). No link type covers a restrictive 'only'; but_rather is limited to 'ki im' after a negative and contrast to 'ulam' or 'efes ki'.

cant_tell.what: Whether g1 should be folded into Exo.8.6#turn1 as a part of it, rather than standing as a separate turn.
cant_tell.why: The members of Exo.8.6#turn1 are not in the input; the text itself shows the same speaker and addressee continuing without a new saying clause, so it is one speech, but I cannot edit a group I cannot see.

cant_tell.what: Whether cl0 is the effect of the imperative group Exo.8.4#imp2 (Pharaoh's request to pray).
cant_tell.why: The request is two verses back and the frogs' departure here is Moses's prediction in reply, not a waw plus weqatal directly following that imperative; no link is added.
